title: HostEvent
description: RFC 0236 §A — an event that belongs to no run. It carries no `runId` and no `sequence`, and no run's log contains it. Delivered on the `hostEvents` channel and, when durable, through webhooks (`events.md` §Host events, `webhooks.md` §Delivery). `delivery` MUST equal the class the host advertises for `type` in its `hostEvents` record.

eventId.description: Unique per host; identical on every delivery attempt of this event.

type.description: A protocol host-event type (`channel.presence`) or a vendor type `org.name` whose org is registered (`events.md` §Naming).

timestamp.description: When the host produced the event (RFC 3339).

delivery.description: `ephemeral`: never persisted, never redelivered, never fanned out. `durable`: resumable by `eventId` and webhook-deliverable.

workspaceId.description: Present exactly when the event belongs to a workspace (`identity.md` §1).

payload.description: For a protocol type, its registered payload schema. A vendor payload MUST NOT carry secret material (SR-1).
